exposure: trophectoderm biopsy for preimplantation genetic testing (PGT)
cohort: The study included 756 patients aged 20-44 years who underwent frozen-thawed embryo transfer (FET) of previously vitrified blastocysts, either biopsied or unbiopsied, resulting in a singleton live birth between 2013 and 2019.
finding: Trophectoderm biopsy was significantly associated with an increased risk of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP) in pregnancies following frozen-thawed embryo transfer cycles.
